summary: Great Southern Bancorp, the Maryland-incorporated holding company for Great Southern Bank, filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026 disclosing that its board declared a $0.43 per common share quarterly cash dividend, payable October 14, 2026 to holders of record September 28, 2026. This marks the 147th consecutive quarterly dividend. No advisor, premium, or structural terms apply; the release is routine shareholder-return disclosure tied to ordinary capital allocation rather than any transaction. Watch for dividend sustainability against bank earnings and any future special-dividend or buyback signals, which would shift the capital-return narrative.
